newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Good granite outlook boosts Marlin shares.
newsitem.headline: Good granite outlook boosts Marlin shares.

text.p: A positive outlook for the South African granite industry boosted shares in producer Marlin Corp by seven cents or 7.3 percent to 1.02 rand on Wednesday.

Marlin posted an attributable profit for the six months to end June of five million rand, up from 1.2 million previously, after being boosted by its recent 13 million rand acquisition of a 71 percent stake in Minaco.
Analysts said the company's results were at, or just below, market expectatations, but that the outlook for the sector was very positive.
"I think the outlook for the granite companies is quite encouraging," one analyst said.
They pointed out that, with all their sales in dollars, the mining producers sector was an excellent place for investors to find rand-hedged stocks.
Other granite producers were also benefitting. At 1020 GMT Kudu Granite was up two cents to 1.32 rand, while Kelgran Ltd was steady at 4.30 rand.
